calculation.expression: ((r20 - median_cross_section(r20)) - (r60 - median_cross_section(r60))) * (1 + 0.35 * clip(log(volume / rolling_median(volume,20)) - median_cross_section(log(volume / rolling_median(volume,20))), -1.5, 1.5))
calculation.description: Relative 20-day versus 60-day return acceleration, strengthened when an instrument's recent volume surprise is above the cross-sectional median and weakened when below; volume-missing observations are neutral. Signal is lagged one completed trading day.

validation.regime_notes: Weak but positive in 2020-2026, strong in 2027-2032, and positive but subdued in 2033-2035; uncertainty is interpreted conservatively because the cross-section has 15 instruments.

provenance.note: Library correlation requires deterministic post-Miner recomputation; null here does not assert zero correlation.
